summary: Extended the DRIFT deployment session by wiring Umami analytics env vars into the CI/CD pipeline so the tracking code gets baked into every future Vite build.
highlights: Added VITE_UMAMI_URL and VITE_UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID as ARG/ENV entries in Dockerfile.client and as --build-arg flags in the GitHub Actions deploy workflow — analytics now baked at image build time, not at runtime
Pushed commit to DRIFT repo; CI triggered and deployed in ~31 seconds
